notes.subject: ⟨ke⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew אין שלום is a verbless clause; Sepedi existential needs the copula 'ke'

notes.subject: לרשעים
notes.rationale: preposition l- rendered 'to/for the wicked'; JPS reads 'concerning the wicked' — scope of the negation differs

notes.subject: go basebeng
notes.rationale: divine oracle addresses the wicked directly through the messenger formula 'go bolela Yahwe'

translation: Ga go ⟨ke⟩ kgotso, go bolela Yahwe, go basebeng.
